data.title: Qawaid o Tanbeeh (Grammar Notes)
data.text: Arabi zaban mein [ اَلْ ] ka matlab “yeh” (khaas) hota hai, aur yeh un alfaaz ke shuru mein lagta hai jinka matlab “yeh” ho. Khaas logon ke naamon (maslan: مُحَمَّدٌ, مُوسَىٰ, فِرْعَوْن) ke shuru mein aam taur par [ اَلْ ] nahi aata. Agar iss sabaq ya aane wale asbaaq mein koi naya lafz mile, toh aasaani ke liye use highlight kar lein.

data.title: Muannath (Feminine) ki Pehchan
data.text: Jin alfaaz ke aakhir mein gol 'ta' [ة / ـة] hoti hai, woh muannath (feminine) hote hain. Gaur karein ke iss sabaq aur pichle sabaq mein kaun kaun se alfaaz muannath hain?

data.title: Lafz se Jumla (Words toh Sentences)
data.text: Lafz se lafz mil kar jumla banta hai. Quran-e-Pak ki aayatein bhi mukhtalif jumle hain. Jis tarah ab aap alfaaz samajhne lage hain, usi tarah mein Sha' Allah bohot jald Quran-e-Pak ki aayatein bhi samajhne lagenge.

data.text: Some More Well-Known Qur'anic Words — Mazeed Mashhoor Qur'ani Alfaaz

Kya aapne kabhi doosre mazameen (subjects) seekhne mein itni mehnat ki hai jitni Quran seekhne mein karte hain? Nahi? Toh aaj hi se faisla karein ke apni poori mehnat aur waqt Quran ke liye lagayenge. Allah aapke saath hai.

data.text: Basic Easy Qur'anic Vocabulary — Bunyadi Aasan Qur'ani Alfaaz
Yeh bunyadi alfaaz aam taur par aap pehchante honge. Nisbatan naye alfaaz ke maani de diye gaye hain.
Yeh kitaab iss andaaz mein tayyar ki gayi hai ke mein Sha' Allah aahista aahista aap Al-Hamd (اَلْحَمْد) se ek-Naas (وَالنَّاس) tak poora Quran samajhne ke qabil ho jayenge!
Alfaaz jaise (الشَّمْسُ, النَّارُ, السَّمَاءُ, الْأَرْضُ, جَهَنَّمُ) ke aakhir mein [ة] nahi hai, lekin Ahle Arab inhein Mu'annath (feminine) maante hain.

data.text: Asaan Arabi Jama Alfaaz (Broken Plurals / Jama Mukassar)
Neeche diye gaye jama ke alfaaz samajhne mein asaan hain. Aap ki sahulat ke liye mein alfaaz ke wahid (singular) bhi saath mein zikr kiye gaye hain.

data.text: Kuch Aur Qur'ani Jama ke Alfaaz (Jama Muannath Saalim — Suffix ات)

Bahut se jama ke alfaaz hain jo [ا] aur [ت] par khatam hote hain jaise [الْجَنَّاتُ] aur [الْبَرَكَاتُ]. Yeh Qur'ani alfaaz aam taur par cheezon ke majmoo'e ya auraton ke giroh ka matlab dete hain. Darj zail alfaaz ko dhyan se padhiye aur unke ma'ani samjhiye.
Yeh alfaaz yaad kar lein. Alfaaz ke aakhir mein (ات) unhe doosre jama ke alfaaz se alag karta hai aur yeh Qur'ek-e-Majeed mein bahut kasrat se aate hain.
Agar yeh jama ke alfaaz (الـ) se shuru na hon toh unke aakhiri harf par tanween aayegi. Jaise (الْآيَاتُ) se (آيَاتٌ). Tamam alfaaz ko shuru mein (الـ) ke baghair padh kar mashq kijiye.

data.text: Upar diye gaye pehle column mein woh alfaaz hain jo aap pichhle asbaaq mein padh chuke hain. Doosre column mein wahi alfaaz thode se farq ke sath dobara aaye hain: unke shuru mein (الْـ) nahi hai aur aakhir mein tanween (ً ٍ ٌ) hai, jaise (كِتَابٌ). Jab koi lafz baghair (الْـ) ke istemaal hota hai, toh aam taur par uska mafhoom 'koi' ya 'ek' (ek / any) hota hai. Arabi mein aur Quran-e-Majeed mein aksar alfaaz (الْـ) se shuru hote hain. Lekin jab kisi lafz se 'koi' ya 'ek' murad lena ho toh (الْـ) hata diya jata hai. Baghair (الْـ) ke lafz par teeno harkaat mein se koi bhi harkat aa sakti hai, iss se uske maani par koi asar nahi padta. Harkaat ke bajaye lafz aur uske maani par tawajjoh dete hue, darj zail alfaaz ke maani samjhein aur likhein:
Mazed Qurani alfaaz (Tanween ke sath):
Kabhi kabhi shuru mein (الْـ) ke baghair do ya zyada Qurani alfaaz (وَ) ke sath mil kar aate hain. Aap mein murakkab alfaaz / fiqron ko aasani se samajh sakte hain:

translations.en: A guidance, mercy, and glad tidings

Darj zail misaalon par ghaur karein:

(هٰذَا) ka matlab Arabic mein 'yeh' (this) hai. (هٰذَا) aur tanween wala lafz milkar ek mukammal aur saada jumla banate hain. (هٰذَا) Arabic mein qareeb ki cheez ki taraf ishaarah karne ke liye istemal hota hai. Aap pehle hi jaan chuke hain ke lafz par tanween aam taur par 'hai' ke mafhoom mein aati hai.
Darj zail alfaaz aur jumlon ka tarjuma kijiye:

Agar (هٰذَا) ke baad aane wala lafz (الْـ) se shuru ho, toh yeh mukammal jumla nahi banta kyunke (هٰذَا) aur agla lafz milkar ek hi cheez banate hain jaise (هٰذَا الْكِتَابُ). Aisi soorat mein yeh do alfaaz aam taur par kisi doosre jumle ka hissa hote hain. iss baat ko behtar samajhne ke liye 'Yeh' aur 'Kitaab' do lafz milkar jumla nahi balke ek murakkab (phrase) banate hain jo jumle mein faa'il ya maf'ool ban sakta hai. Pehle misaal ki tarah baaqi Quranic murakkabaat ka tarjuma karein:
(مَتَىٰ) ka matlab 'kab' (when) hai aur iske saath milkar ek mukammal jumla banta hai. Niche diye gaye do jumlon ka tarjuma aap khud kijiye:

Darj zail misaalon par ghaur karein:

(ذٰلِكَ) aam taur par Arabic mein door ki cheez ki taraf ishaarah karne ke liye istemal hota hai, jabke (هٰذَا) qareeb ke liye hota hai. (ذٰلِكَ) ke baad aam taur par tanween wala lafz aata hai jisse ek mukammal jumla banta hai. Darj zail jumlon ko samjhein aur tarjuma kijiye:

Guftagu mein (ذٰلِكَ) aam taur par door ki cheez ki taraf ishaarah karne ke liye istemal hota hai, lekin Quran-e-Kareem mein yeh aksar qareeb ki cheez ke liye bhi 'yeh' (this) ke ma'na mein aata hai. Upar diye gaye jumlon ka tarjuma aapne 'woh' se kiya hai, ab inhein 'yeh' ke ma'na mein samajhein jaise ﴿ذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ﴾ 'Yeh behtar hai'.

(ذٰلِكَ) ke baad agar aisa lafz aaye jo (الْـ) se shuru hota ho toh uske do mafhoom bante hain: 1. Yeh ek murakkab (phrase) banta hai jaise (ذٰلِكَ الْكِتَابُ). Aisi soorat mein jumla mukammal nahi hota, iss liye 'hai' nahi aayega. Pehle misaal ke mutabiq baaqi Quranic murakkabaat ka tarjuma kijiye:

2. Yeh ek mukammal jumla bhi banta hai jisme taakeed (emphasis) maqsood hoti hai, jaise darj zail Quranic jumlon mein dekha ja sakta hai. Aayat ke siyaaq-o-sabaaq se aap samajh sakte hain ke kaunsa mafhoom munasib hai:
Yaad rakhein! iss kitaab ko padhte waqt na kisi se tarjuma poochein aur na kahin aur dekhein, kyunke aahista aahista aap khud tamaam ayaat samajhne ke qaabil ho jayenge. mein sha Allah!

data.text: Upar zikr kiye gaye tamaam Quranic alfaaz ke aakhir mein (ة/ـة) hai. Aise tamaam alfaaz Arabic mein muannath hote hain aur mein alfaaz ke liye ism-e-ishaarah (هٰذِهِ) aayega. Kuch aise alfaaz bhi hain jin ke aakhir mein (ة/ـة) nahi hai lekin Arabic mein unhein muannath maana jaata hai jaise (جَهَنَّمُ), (نَارٌ), (سَمَاءٌ), (أَرْضٌ). Ab aap darj zail jumlon ko khud samajh kar tarjuma kijiye:
Door ki muannath cheez ke liye ism-e-ishaarah (تِلْكَ) hota hai. Darj zail Quranic jumlon ko khud samjhein aur tarjuma karein:

(تِلْكَ) aam taur par door ki muannath cheez ke liye istemal hota hai, lekin Quran-e-Kareem mein yeh aksar 'yeh' (this) ke mafhoom mein aata hai aur isi tarah samajhna chahiye. Upar aapne 'woh' se tarjuma kiya, ab dobara 'yeh' ke ma'na mein tarjuma kijiye.

Agar (تِلْكَ) ya (هٰذِهِ) ke baad aane wala lafz (الْـ) se shuru ho jaise (الشَّجَرَةُ, النَّارُ) toh jumla mukammal nahi hota, kyunke (هٰذِهِ) aur (الْـ) wala lafz milkar ek murakkab banate hain. iss liye tarjuma mein 'hai' nahi aayega. Di gayi misaal ko saamne rakh kar darj zail lafzon ka khud tarjuma karein:

Quran-e-Majeed ko samajhne ke liye alfaaz, mukhtalif qism ke jumle, muhaavre aur chand zaroori qawaid jaanna zaroori hai. iss kitaab mein mein Sha Allah aap yeh sab cheezein aahista aahista aasaani se seekh lenge!

data.text: Darj zail misaalein dekhein:

examples.translation: Ibrat / sabaq hai ➔ Yaqeenan ibrat hai

translations.hinglish: Ibrat / sabaq hai ➔ Yaqeenan ibrat hai

data.text: Upar di gayi misaalon mein pehle column ke teen alfaaz (الْـ) ke baghair hain. Agle column mein unhi alfaaz ke shuru mein (لَـ) laga hua hai. Kisi lafz ke shuru mein (لَـ) lagaane se us mein 'yaqeenan', 'beshak' ya 'bila-shuba' ke ma'ani paida ho jaate hain. iss tarah poore lafz ka ma'ana 'yaqeenan woh ek ... hai' hota hai. (لَـ) wala lafz aam taur par jumle ke aakhir mein aata hai. Aise alfaaz Qur'ek-e-Kareem mein bakasrat istemal hue hain.
Ab aap darj zail jumlon ko khud samajh kar tarjuma kar sakte hain:

Ta'keed ka (لَـ) baaz auqaat un alfaaz ke shuru mein bhi aata hai jo (الْـ) se shuru hote hain. Aisi soorat mein (الْـ) ka alif gir jaata hai aur dono laam aapas mein mil jaate hain (jaise الْـ + لَـ = لَلْـ) aur tarjuma mein 'yaqeenan' ka izafa hota hai. Darj zail Qur'ani jumlon ko samjhein aur tarjuma karein:

Yeh ta'keed ka (لَـ) Qur'ek-e-Majeed mein mukhtalif alfaaz ke saath kasrat se istemal hota hai aur iss se kalaam mein shadeed ta'keed (zor) paida hota hai. Aane wale sabaqon mein tarjuma karte waqt iss baat ko achhi tarah zehen mein rakhein.
Agar aap Qur'ek-e-Pak ko nahin samajhte, toh iski zimmedari kisi doosre fard, giroh ya qaum par nahin balki khud aap par aaid hoti hai, aur aakhirat mein iski baaz-purs (hisaab) khud aap hi se hogi.
Darj zail alfaaz par ghaur karein, unki banawat aur ma'ani ko dekhein:

Upar diye gaye alfaaz mein chand baatein mushtarak (ek jaisi) hain: Har lafz chaar huroof par mushtamil hai, har lafz ke shuru mein (أَ) hai, aur sab par aaraab (harakat) ek jaise hain. Arabi mein iss wazan (أَفْعَلُ) par aane wale alfaaz Ism-e-Tafzeel (Superlative) hote hain, jin mein kisi sift ki inteha ya sabse zyada hone ka ma'ana paida hota hai. Yeh alfaaz logon ke naamon ke taur par bhi aam istemal hote hain, jaise Akram (sabse ba-izzat) ya Afzal (sabse behtar).
Ab aap darj zail alfaaz ko khud samajh sakte hain:
Darasal (خَيْرٌ) aur (شَرٌّ) asal mein (أَخْيَرُ) aur (أَشَرُّ) yeh, jin ka hamza kasrat-e-istemal ki wajah se gira diya gaya.
Ab aap darj zail Qur'ani jumlon ka tarjuma khud kar sakte hain:
